diagnostic: Orca serve aborted with SIGABRT on macOS. This most often happens at application startup, when the process cannot register with Launch Services (_RegisterApplication / +[NSApplication sharedApplication]) before any Orca JavaScript runs. That is common in sandboxed agent environments, SSH sessions without a GUI login, and CI. Confirm the crashing frame in the crash report; this is not the Electron UTF-8 write abort (electron/electron#51871).
